newsitem.title: ITALY: Ferrari 1996 sales rise 14 pct to 800 bln lire.
newsitem.headline: Ferrari 1996 sales rise 14 pct to 800 bln lire.

text.p: Italy's Ferrari sports car maker saw 1996 sales rise 14 percent to some 800 billion lire ($510 million), a company spokesman said.
Ferrari car sales rose seven percent to 3,313 vehicles. Last year Ferrari forecast it would sell 3,000 to 3,500 cars while for 1997 it hopes to consolidate its already "particularly solid" position.
The United States remains Ferrari's main market with 700 cars sold in 1996, up six percent. Sales in Britain were 330, up 15 percent, and 250 in Japan, a rise of 24 percent.
Sales in Italy and Germany were steady, at 500 and 400 respectively.
The spokesman said Ferraris will be sold this year for the first time in Russia and South Korea. ((-- Rome newsroom +396 6782501 ))
